steps.content: After a fierce fight, the ducks' offense gradually fades. You rush to their retreat and find both used and unused photos left behind.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: So these are the weapons they use for attacks? They seem disposable. Each photo can only activate an ability once.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: But seeing my signature move perfectly replicated by these ducks is still really weird! It's giving me some serious chills!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: And why do they have so many photos of Sinners?! Look—There's tons of Chief too!

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Chief's photos aren't that surprising though, after all, they are in short supply in the...

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Ahem... I mean, there are quite a few shortcuts in the Bureau. Wouldn't taking this path here save us some time?
